plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. HEADING AS PRINTED: the map page heads 'UCTP Chemistry map for 2026-2027' followed by the printed disclaimer 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map page does NOT print a 'This pathway map is for catalog year ...' sentence; the 2026-2027 catalog year is taken from the map heading and the program page's 2026-2027 catalog-year selection. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated, except the small closed sets named in these notes where the browser verified them. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This plan transcribes the only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / UCTP Chemistry / Associate in Science for Transfer / 74-77.5 units / 5 terms / to UC', in full. The program's 2025-2026 mapper version offered a single pathway printed as 74-77.5 units over 7 terms to UC; it is not collected (the current 2026-2027 map is collected instead). The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 16-17 / 6-7 / 19 / 18 and a plan total of 74-77.5 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 74 units. All eleven named courses are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. All eleven named courses carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no row shows a 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. Term 3 is a Summer term as printed (Summer 2027). Term 4 and Term 5 each print an 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slot; each is recorded as its own choice slot exactly as printed (codes BC-A4-4 and BC-A4-5). No 'Major List' slot appears on this map. Small closed dropdown sets verified by the browser on this map: Area 1A (EMLS B1A, EMLS B1AL, ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000E); Area 1C (COMM C1000 only); Area 1B (COMM B15, ENGL C1001, ENGL C1003, HIST B9, PHIL B8, PHIL B9); Area 6 (ETHN B30B, ETHN B35, HIST B30B, PHIL B35). Per the standing slot convention these options are named here only and the slots are recorded unselected.
